'''Alexandre Dufresne'''<ref name="dt-18976">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18976 The Generators Gone], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 17 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18976/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18976/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Lord Kenobi''') posted a [[Light]] [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]] list on DeckTech in September 2001.
